svg.title: Proteor Printing Solutions network topology
svg.desc: Proteor Printing Solutions: Production facility · UniFi Dream Machine SE. 5 VLANs with clients (1 Default, 2 Staff / Main, 8 FI-Machines, 11 Local Extrusion Line, 13 VoIP); 8 more with none (3 Security, 4 Servers, 5 IoT, 6 Guest, 7 GoogleWiFi, 9 Guest-Employee, 10 FI-Machines-Production, 12 Temp Network). 7 UniFi devices, 13 networks, 71 clients.
